body: The pool defaulted to 5 connections, so bursts queued behind each other and eventually gave up. Raise pool_size to 20 and set a 2s acquire timeout so a stuck query fails fast instead of stalling every caller.

summary: chose Redis over an in-process cache
body: An in-process cache drifts between replicas after a deploy: two nodes answer differently for the same key. Redis keeps one shared view and the extra hop costs about a millisecond.
queries: where should the cache live
de ce nu tinem cache-ul in interiorul procesului

summary: git commit hangs when signing is on and there is no terminal
body: A global commit.gpgsign true makes a non-interactive commit wait forever for a passphrase prompt that nobody can answer. Pass -c commit.gpgsign=false in scripts and CI.

summary: plain files under version control as the source of truth, not a database
body: A database makes the data readable only through its own tooling and a corrupt file unrecoverable. Text under version control can be diffed, reviewed and restored with ordinary tools; the index on top is derived and disposable.
queries: why not keep everything in sqlite

summary: deploys go over rsync + ssh with an isolated key agent
body: The deploy script starts its own agent with only the deploy key loaded, so the desktop keychain never takes part and a wrong key cannot reach production.

summary: ffmpeg drops a GIF's last long-delay frame when converting to video
body: The final pause of an animation is not honoured, so the encoded file ends before the last state is visible. Clone the last frame with the tpad filter, then verify by decoding the final frame rather than trusting the reported duration.
queries: the converted clip ends before the final screen

summary: test a fleet change on one device before rolling it out
